payload.rationale: Compose only fresh destination authors and preserve their authenticated lineage.

limits: Continuity covers the same immutable proposal and the entire selected review basis, not another proposal or a claim of prose truth.
Every intervening governance increment must be a recorded content-policy transition preserving the selected catalog context on both sides.
A selected-policy change followed by a return to its old value does not restore the old opinion.
A direct governance policy update, even with the same body, is a barrier rather than a continuity transition.
At most 64 intervening transitions are examined; a recent verified direct-policy barrier invalidates older opinions, while otherwise unresolved history requires reconsideration or grant revocation.
Original grant validity, current heads, scope, contributor separation, formal review and runtime freshness remain separate requirements.
The SQLite owner and local clock remain trusted; hashes do not authenticate people, establish independent expertise or externally attest history.

data.meaning_check: Exact quote presence only; not an entailment or truth judgment

data.rationale: Programmed fresh destination decision; independent human or model review is not established.

limits: Routing covers only administrator-declared sections; completeness over other text or project requirements is not established.
Every touched section and its complete transitive overlap component is required; disjoint sections remain separate bundles.
Exact unique quotations and resolved fields pin declared locations; correspondence between prose and those fields is not inferred or verified.
Literal Python declarations do not establish program behavior; proposed code is parsed with bounded AST rules and is never executed.
Matches do not establish prose truth, external evidence, human identity, independent people or independent models.
A standalone packet does not authorize acceptance; formal review, current runtime bases, authorship and governance remain separate requirements.
The SQLite owner and application implementation remain trusted; hashes provide internal consistency rather than external certification.
